blind_spot: The five §6 lines and D-37 (ה) declare the five E2E failures 'pre-existing' on the strength of a baseline I did not run, and the one thing that would make that verdict wrong is invisible in the logs I did read: both baseline runs were served by a single long-lived preview (the orchestrator's own reported blind spot). A stale or wrongly-built dist/ served to both runs would reproduce the same five failures byte-identically and would look exactly like what I measured — same locators, same expected/received, same order. Checkable true-or-false in one command pair that nobody has run: inside .claude/worktrees/wf_256b7ec8-ebb-4, `npm run build`, then `npx playwright test --config=playwright.e2e.config.js e2e/prices.spec.js` against a preview started AFTER that build. prices.spec.js is the decisive one: its failure claims the screen prints 'ערך חוקי: מספר שלם בין 1 ל-150', which src/lib/paramsRegistry.js:292-299 generates. If the fresh preview prints the same string, the baseline is real; if it prints 'מספר שלם חיובי', the preview was serving an old bundle and that debt line — and the confidence of the other four — is wrong.
